name: script-kml
script:

set xml to XMLChild xmlTop index 1
set xml to XMLChild xml index 1
set cnt to XMLCount xml
set xml to XMLFind xml name "Placemark"
set node to XMLChild xml index 1
XMLGetText node
set node to XMLChild xml index 2

set pointNode to XMLChild xml index 4

XMLGetText node
set xml to XMLNextSibling xml
set node to XMLChild xml index 1
XMLGetText node
XMLClose xmlTop

set xml to XMLFind (XMLChild xmlTop index 1) name "Placemark"

set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set b to XMLChild r index 1
XMLSetText (XMLChild b index 1) to "New & <title>"
XMLGetText (XMLChild b index 1)
XMLDisplayXML d
XMLClose d

name: change-set-text-element
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set b to XMLChild r index 1
XMLSetText b to "just text"
XMLCount b
XMLDisplayXML d
XMLClose d

name: change-set-text-list
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set b to XMLChild r index 1
XMLSetText {XMLChild b index 1, XMLChild b index 3} to {"T", "Y"}
XMLDisplayXML d
XMLClose d

name: change-set-text-missing-value
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set b to XMLChild r index 1
XMLSetText {XMLChild b index 1, XMLChild b index 3} to {missing value, "Y"}
XMLDisplayXML d
XMLClose d

name: change-set-text-suppressing
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set b to XMLChild r index 1
XMLSetText {XMLChild b index 1, XMLChild b index 3} to {missing value, "Y"} with suppressing

XMLClose d

name: change-set-text-number
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set b to XMLChild r index 1
XMLSetText (XMLChild b index 3) to 1900
XMLDisplayXML d
XMLClose d

name: change-append-text
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set b to XMLChild r index 1
XMLAppendText " (novel)" at (XMLChild b index 1)
XMLGetText (XMLChild b index 1)

XMLClose d

name: change-append-text-empty-element
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLAppendText "filled" at (XMLFind r name "empty")
XMLGetText (XMLFind r name "empty")
XMLDisplayXML d
XMLClose d

name: ns-get
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/namespaces.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLGetNameSpace r
XMLGetNameSpace (XMLChild r index 1)
XMLGetNameSpace (XMLChild r index 2)
XMLClose d

name: ns-get-none
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/namespaces.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLGetNameSpace (XMLRoot (XMLOpen from string "<a/>"))
XMLClose d

name: ns-get-attribute
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/namespaces.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLGetNameSpace (XMLChild r index 1)
XMLClose d

name: ns-get-all
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/namespaces.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLGetNameSpaces r
XMLGetNameSpaces (XMLChild (XMLChild r index 3) index 1)
XMLClose d

name: ns-from-prefix
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/namespaces.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLGetNameSpaceFromPrefix r prefix "a"
XMLGetNameSpaceFromPrefix r prefix ""
XMLGetNameSpaceFromPrefix (XMLChild (XMLChild r index 3) index 1) prefix "c"
XMLClose d

name: ns-from-prefix-missing
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/namespaces.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d

XMLClose d

name: ns-add
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/namespaces.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLAddNamespace {nsprefix:"n", nsurl:"urn:new"} at r
XMLGetNameSpaces r
XMLDisplayXML r without formatting
XMLClose d

name: ns-add-default
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/namespaces.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLAddNamespace {nsprefix:"", nsurl:"urn:other"} at (XMLChild r index 2)
XMLDisplayXML r without formatting
XMLClose d

name: ns-add-existing-prefix
script:

set r to XMLRoot d
XMLAddNamespace {nsprefix:"a", nsurl:"urn:changed"} at r
XMLClose d

name: ns-attribute-with-namespace
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/namespaces.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLGetAttribute (XMLChild r index 1) name "attr" namespace "urn:b"
XMLGetAttribute (XMLChild r index 1) name "attr"
XMLClose d

name: search-find-name

name: search-find-all

name: search-find-missing
script:

name: search-find-missing-all
script:

name: search-find-self

set r to XMLRoot d

name: search-find-in-document
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLTagName (XMLFind d name "title")

name: search-find-nothing
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLFind r
XMLClose d

name: search-find-text
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set t to XMLFindText "Hugo" in r
XMLNodeInfo t
XMLTagName (XMLParent t)

name: search-find-text-all
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLFindText "e" in r with all occurrences

name: search-find-text-missing
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLFindText "zzz" in r

name: search-find-text-case
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLFindText "hugo" in r

name: search-find-text-cdata
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLFindText "cdata" in r with all occurrences
XMLClose d

name: search-regexp
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLGetText (XMLRegexp "^[0-9]{4}$" in r)
XMLClose d

name: search-regexp-all
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLRegexp "[0-9]" in r with all occurrences
XMLClose d

script:

set r to XMLRoot d

name: search-regexp-invalid
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLRegexp "([" in r

name: search-regexp-missing
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/simple.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
XMLRegexp "^zzz$" in r

name: url-base
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/base.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set leaf to XMLChild (XMLChild r index 1) index 1
XMLBase d
XMLBase r
XMLBase leaf
XMLClose d

name: url-base-as-alias
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/base.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set leaf to XMLChild (XMLChild r index 1) index 1
XMLBase d as alias
XMLClose d

name: url-set-base
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/base.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set leaf to XMLChild (XMLChild r index 1) index 1
XMLSetBase leaf to "other/"
XMLBase leaf
XMLDisplayXML r without formatting
XMLClose d

name: url-set-base-empty
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/base.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set leaf to XMLChild (XMLChild r index 1) index 1
XMLSetBase (XMLChild r index 1) to ""
XMLBase leaf
XMLClose d

name: url-absolute
script:
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/base.xml")
set r to XMLRoot d
set leaf to XMLChild (XMLChild r index 1) index 1
XMLAbsoluteURL "file.html" from leaf
XMLAbsoluteURL "../x.html" from leaf
XMLAbsoluteURL "http://other.com/y" from leaf
XMLClose d

name: url-absolute-from-url

set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/base.xml")

set leaf to XMLChild (XMLChild r index 1) index 1
XMLAbsoluteURL "b.html" from "http://h.com/a/"

set r to XMLRoot d
set leaf to XMLChild (XMLChild r index 1) index 1
XMLAbsoluteURL "simple.xml" from d as alias
XMLClose d

name: url-relative
script:

set leaf to XMLChild (XMLChild r index 1) index 1
XMLRelativeURL "http://example.com/dir/sub/other.html" from leaf
XMLRelativeURL "http://example.com/x.html" from leaf
XMLClose d

name: error-level
script:
set old to XMLErrorLevel
XMLErrorLevel 3
XMLErrorLevel old

name: error-level-3-opens-invalid
script:
set old to XMLErrorLevel 3
try
set d to XMLOpen (POSIX file "$FILES/invalid.xml")
XMLDisplayXML d
XMLClose d
end try
XMLErrorLevel old

name: error-level-1-warning
script:
set old to XMLErrorLevel 1
try
set d to XMLOpen from string "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"nonsense\"?><a/>"
XMLClose d
end try
XMLError
XMLErrorLevel old

name: extended-char
script: set old to XMLExtendedChar true set d to XMLOpen from string "xy" XMLGetText (XMLRoot d) XMLClose d XMLExtendedChar old

name: extended-char-off
script: set old to XMLExtendedChar false set d to XMLOpen from string "xy" XMLExtendedChar old

name: indent-string
script:
set old to XMLSetIndentString "    "
XMLSetIndentString old
